_comment: Agent-1 hub anchors (multi-banjar). Each hub runs the trigger independently: PM2.5 sensors within AQ_RADIUS_KM of {lat,lng} are checked for a sustained exceedance. Add a hub by appending an object with name/lat/lng. Coordinates flagged APPROX must be field-confirmed before the hub goes live in production.
